metric_method.garbage_time: Exclude offense/defense plays outside preplay WP 5%-95%; retain unknown WP

metric_method.field_goals: Made indicator minus other teams' current-season distance-bin make rate, >=5 peer attempts
metric_method.net_punting: Nonblocked punt distance minus return yards minus 20 for touchbacks
metric_method.return_coverage: Team-perspective EPA per punt/kickoff opportunity; provisional combined return/coverage metric
